subject: Important Update Regarding Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you that there have been some changes to our account management system. As part of our ongoing efforts to improve security and user experience, we have implemented a new two-factor authentication process. This additional layer of protection will help safeguard your account from unauthorized access. Please log in to your account to set up two-factor authentication as soon as possible. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
